label: Emeraldella-inspired antenna crawler
scope: Original child-friendly evidence-informed scene prop, not scientific reconstruction; candidate only, parent integration.
design: Smooth seafoam semicircular eyeless head; eleven curved overlapping trunk plates taper to two cylindrical rings and a slender continuous tail spine. Long swept antennae. Ochre ventral walking branches and subdued pale swimming lobes. Broad head and upper plates stay visually quiet.
concept_interpretation: Top and lateral concepts agree on eyeless head, taper and long spine; illustrated plate counts are suggestive only. Freeze eleven trunk plates and two rings. Fine limb architecture is deliberately generalized.
dimensions: Nominal authoring unit 0.05m; final actual XYZ bounds measured in metadata. Supporting prop scale is artistic, not a specimen measurement. Burgessia carapace 0.014m; Tuzoia carapace 0.09m; Emeraldella body about 0.065m; Sanctacaris body about 0.075m.

budgets.role: supporting small scene life, 128px; inspectable at 512px
budgets.mount_origin: authored body midline; ground-normalized lowest appendage to Z=0, identity root
budgets.runtime_target: Three.js 0.180.0; parent independent runtime/GPU/populated-scene QA pending

viewing: Supporting scene at 0.2-1m nominal camera distance; 128px identification, 512px inspection.
construction: Explicit closed volumetric profile/radial shell meshes; closed tapered path tubes for antennae, tail and limbs. Editable semantic parts; deliberate flat planes. No texture billboards or borrowed geometry.
hidden_surfaces: Closed lower shield surfaces; paired volumetric limbs and swimming lobes beneath shells, real hinge/body depth; no camera-specific flattening. Separate closed parts intentionally intersect at joints; not a print-ready union.
proof: Exact clean-import GLB, shared repository renderer; concept-match uses authored 55deg azimuth/32deg elevation as approximate illustration view, not calibrated camera. All revisions must retain config.
credits: Original art/renders/prose CC-BY-4.0 Leon Made This / s010s; code MIT. ROM factual consultation only.
revision_policy: Only adopt bounded revisions with named visible gains; preserve earlier outputs.
bounded_revision: Replace kinked antenna centerlines with twelve-station cubic arcs, retaining tapered closed cross sections and endpoint role.
comparison: Lock r001 camera target, orthographic scale and lights; compare concept-match/top/right/clay views. Adopt only if the named contour change is visible.
